techniques.name: The Flames of Purity
techniques.desc: Creatures with Shadowlands Taint cannot explode 10s on attack or damage rolls against you.

techniques.name: Hida's Strength
techniques.desc: Gain Reduction 8, added to Reduction from armor and other Techniques.

techniques.name: The Crab Are the Wall
techniques.desc: Once each round, immediately remove one Condition affecting you. Mounted and Grappled cannot be removed this way.

narrative.label: I fairly defeated a current Kenshinzen in a legal iaijutsu duel. The duel need not have been fatal.

techniques.name: Drawing the Void
techniques.desc: While in Center Stance, add 10 to your Armor TN.

techniques.name: Kakita's Strength
techniques.desc: During an iaijutsu duel, your Assessment and Focus dice explode on 9 as well as 10.

techniques.name: A Single Moment
techniques.desc: If you make only one attack during your Turn, an opponent you hit is Stunned until your next Turn begins.

techniques.name: The Silence of Two Strikes
techniques.desc: With a katana in your main hand and a wakizashi in your off hand, you may spend Void Points twice during a Turn.

techniques.name: Mirumoto's Strength
techniques.desc: Your Focus roll in an iaijutsu duel always receives the +1k1 Assessment benefit, regardless of the Assessment result. Your opponent may independently earn that benefit too.

techniques.name: Harmony and Precision
techniques.desc: While wielding a katana in your main hand and a wakizashi in your off hand, ignore your opponents' Reduction.

narrative.label: My character is female, as required for the Lion's Pride.

techniques.name: The Fury of Matsu
techniques.desc: While in Full Attack Stance, add 10 to your Armor TN.

techniques.name: Paragon of Honor
techniques.desc: Opponents within 30 feet whose Honor Rank is lower than yours cannot explode 10s. An opponent may spend 2 Void Points during the Reactions Stage to ignore this effect for the encounter.

techniques.name: Matsu's Technique
techniques.desc: When an opponent declares a melee attack against you before you have taken your Turn that round, spend 1 Void Point to make a Simple Action attack against them first. Your Turn then has only one Simple Action, with Free Actions still allowed. This response is available in Full Attack Stance.

techniques.name: Strength of Suitengu
techniques.desc: Treat your Shugenja School Rank as 1 higher when casting Water spells. Spend 1 Void Point and a Complex Action to strike one target within Water Ring x 10 feet with lightning. Damage is Air Ring rolled and kept. Each spell slot spent adds +1k0 damage; spend no more slots than your Storm Rider Rank.

techniques.name: The Raging Ocean
techniques.desc: Increase your Shugenja School Rank by 1. Treat your Water Ring as 2 higher when determining your daily Water spell slots.

techniques.name: Child of Osano-Wo
techniques.desc: Treat your Shugenja School Rank as another 1 higher when casting Water spells. Spend 1 Void Point as a Free Action to become immune to Thunder-keyword spells of Mastery Level 3 or lower for three rounds.

techniques.name: Name of the Elements
techniques.desc: Treat your Shugenja School Rank as 1 higher when casting spells of your chosen element. Spend 1 Void Point as a Free Action to add twice your chosen Ring to your Armor TN for a number of minutes equal to your Shugenja School Rank. This protection produces a visible elemental effect.

techniques.name: Touch of the Elements
techniques.desc: Increase your Shugenja School Rank by 1. Treat your chosen Ring as 2 higher when determining that element's daily spell slots.

techniques.name: Shape of the Elements
techniques.desc: Treat your Shugenja School Rank as another 1 higher when casting spells of your chosen element. Select one spell of that element with Mastery Level 3 or higher. A number of times daily equal to your Void Ring, you may cast that spell with one Simple Action.

narrative.label: My Blackmail covers at least four different people.
I disclosed at least one of my Dark Secrets to the Instigator sensei on joining.

techniques.name: The Depths of Dishonor
techniques.desc: On a contested Social Skill roll, gain extra unkept dice equal to the difference between your Honor Rank and your opponent's Honor Rank.

techniques.name: Sheath Your Lies in Truth
techniques.desc: When a contested Social Skill roll determines whether someone detects your lie, spend 1 Void Point for +3k3 instead of the usual +1k1. Obviously false claims can still damage your reputation.

techniques.name: Pull the String
techniques.desc: Converse with a Blackmail subject for 10 minutes, then spend 1 Void Point as a Complex Action and win Courtier (Manipulation) / Awareness against their Etiquette (Courtesy) / Willpower. Suggest an action that is neither life-threatening nor worse in consequence than disclosure. They must carry it out or lose 4 Honor points.

narrative.label: I survived a skirmish with an Obsidian Warrior sensei.

techniques.name: Darkness Is My Light
techniques.desc: There is no limit on the number of Raises you may call.

techniques.name: The Power of Impurity
techniques.desc: Opponents within 30 feet subtract your Strength Rank plus Taint Rank from their Bugei roll and damage roll totals. An opponent may spend 1 Void Point to ignore this effect for their Turn.

techniques.name: My Strength Has No Limits
techniques.desc: Add unkept dice equal to your Strength Rank plus Taint Rank when resisting Intimidation or Fear, and on your melee-weapon damage rolls.

narrative.label: I am a devout follower of the Lords of Death, or this campaign is set before the year 1160.

techniques.name: Pale Face of Death
techniques.desc: At the start of your Turn, spend 1 Void Point as a Free Action and choose one opponent within 30 feet. Their actions suffer TN penalties equal to your Lore: Theology Rank for the rest of the encounter. Only one target may be affected at a time.

techniques.name: Moto's Strength
techniques.desc: Ignore wound TN penalties up to twice your Lore: Theology Rank.

techniques.name: Fury of Heaven
techniques.desc: When making an attack, spend 1 Void Point to add five times your Lore: Theology Rank to the attack roll total.
